scenario: count_of / contains are exact only over a bounded `sliding` window in v1 (LSER.16.6 / 16.7). The `all_time` form would need an unbounded exact frequency table / set, which v1 does not ship — so it is reserved for v2 and rejected at compile. Pin: `count_of all_time` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_EXACT_BACKING; the diagnostic points at the bounded `sliding` form.
